records.name: Heighten Your Enlightenment
records.notes: IRS lists this as a nonprofit (EIN 208994643), but the site calls itself a nonprofit LLC and describes career coaching, mentorship, food donations and mental health support delivered by appointment, with an intake form and set business hours. It has no dated events or public programs and no volunteer or member way in, so it reads as a coaching service rather than a community group. Owner may override if the food or support work is a free, open public program.

records.name: Kuvuna Foundation USA

Its programs, events and any way to join could not be checked. IRS address is 7500 Germantown Ave, 19119. The name suggests a foundation. Whether it is a grant or family fund that should be hidden as private is not established. Held back until a source is found.

records.name: Lifeline Music Coalition
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that puts on jazz concerts and festivals and lists a jazz ensemble program. The concerts it has listed were free to attend, but no upcoming dates were posted when checked.
records.what_you_do: Go to a jazz concert or festival the group puts on, or contact the group about its jazz ensemble or about booking musicians.

schedule.text: No upcoming dates were posted when checked. The most recent dated concert in the visible page text was in April 2023.

cost.text: The concerts listed on the page were free to attend.

first_step.how: Email lifelinemusic@comcast.net or call 215-421-3688 to ask about upcoming concerts or the Arpeggio Jazz Ensemble
first_step.basis: The page lists no membership or audition process and no upcoming events, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: IRS legal name Lifeline Music Coalition Inc. Dormant by the dated evidence: the newest dated item in visible text is the April 30, 2023 concert on the home page. The events page shows April 2024 concert dates only in image file names, so those were not counted. No jazz tag exists in the vocabulary; community_band is the closest tag for the Arpeggio Jazz Ensemble. Philadelphia Undefeated Jazz Festival is linked from the site with no date shown.

records.name: Mauckingbird Theatre Company
records.summary: A theatre company that puts on plays. Its current show is a modern take on A Midsummer Night's Dream, presented with Hedgerow Theatre. Audiences buy tickets, and actors audition for specific shows when a call goes out.
records.what_you_do: Buy tickets to the current show through the site, or watch for an audition notice for a specific production.

schedule.text: Dates for the current production were not shown when checked. Actor calls are posted for specific shows.

cost.text: Tickets are sold through the site. Prices were not shown when checked.

first_step.how: Buy tickets to the current production through the Tickets link on the homepage
first_step.basis: Shows are open to the public with online tickets, and actor calls are open when posted

records.notes: Status is a judgment. The homepage shows a current production with a ticket link but no dates, and the only dated item found is a March 2016 audition notice on the Opportunities page. It is probably_active only because the current show is live. The page does not say where the production plays, and the partner theatre is not named with an address. The IRS address (8708 Prospect Ave, Apt B6) is an apartment, not a venue. The copyright line on the site is not counted as evidence. The site lists an email contact, but its address is hidden in page code and was not recorded.

records.name: New Beginning Foundation
records.summary: A nonprofit that works to lift up underserved communities through education, literacy, the creative arts and youth development. It hosts fundraisers, outreach events and seminars, and it takes volunteers.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer a few hours a week or month, or offer a specific skill. You can also attend a fundraiser or outreach event, or sign up for updates.

schedule.text: The office is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm. The site mentions an events calendar, but no dated events were shown when checked.

cost.text: No fees for volunteering are listed. The group asks for donations.

first_step.how: Email l.denis@nbfoundation-inc.org or call 856-438-0479 to offer a few hours a month or a skill
first_step.basis: Volunteering and events are open to the public, and the site gives a sign-up form and contact details

records.notes: IRS filing address is 4542 Greene St # 44 (zip 19144); the site gives 4544 Greene St, which is used here. The only date on the site is a 2026 copyright footer, which is not evidence, so status is probably_active on the rule for working sites with no dates. The events page returned HTTP 404. The site mentions a fitness partner at the NB Center; not recorded as a separate group. Youth development is named on the site; only literacy is tagged.

records.name: Northeast Feltmakers Guild
records.summary: A volunteer-run guild for people who make felt, at every skill level. Its free meetings and workshops happen on Zoom, and it keeps a free library of tutorials. Members also get in-person workshops and a spring retreat.
records.what_you_do: Join a free Zoom meeting or workshop, or become a member to take part in the in-person workshops, the spring retreat and the member shows. Members can also volunteer on committees.

schedule.text: Free regular meetings and workshops on Zoom, announced on the site. Members also get a spring retreat and a November business meeting. Day and time were not shown when checked.

cost.text: Zoom meetings and the free tutorial library cost nothing. Guild membership is $50 a year, renews automatically, and gives subsidized workshops and retreat access.

first_step.how: Join a free Zoom meeting (open to everyone), or click Join on the Join Us page to become a member for $50 a year
first_step.basis: The guild says it welcomes members at every skill level and lists free meetings open to everyone, with a clear join button

records.notes: IRS filing name Northeast Feltmakers Guild. The contact page lists two gmail addresses; the one shown as the main contact is recorded. The Feltuary challenge with its first prompt on February 1, 2026 is the newest dated item in visible text. A 2026 April retreat registration page exists, but its date is only in the page link, so it is not used as the sign of life. Years on the show listings (Lexart, Worcester Center) are not stated on the page and were not used. The August challenge date has no year.

records.name: Northwest CLT
records.summary: A nonprofit community land trust that raises money to buy land for affordable housing. It runs a fundraising page to fund land purchases.
records.what_you_do: Give through the group's Givebutter fundraising page or contact the group. Volunteer roles and events could not be checked.

cost.text: No fees are listed. The group asks for donations toward its land purchases.

first_step.how: Email info@northwestclt.org to ask how a neighbor can help, or give through the group's Givebutter page
first_step.basis: No page that could be read describes how to volunteer or attend, so the way in is unclear

records.notes: IRS legal name Northwest CLT Corporation. The IRS filing lists 45 E Penn Street (zip 19144) and the email info@northwestclt.org. The group's own site (northwestclt.org) returned HTTP 404 at both the bare and www addresses. The one search found a Givebutter fundraising page (18 percent of a $25,000 goal, with no dates) and no dated news about the group. The Penn Street office is not confirmed by any page read. St. Luke's Episcopal Church in Germantown is named as a partner in press coverage; that was not read. A separate group, Philadelphia Community Land Trust, is a different organization and was not merged.

records.name: Philadelphia Ceili Group
records.summary: An Irish music and dance group in Philadelphia, founded in 1958. It runs a free monthly ceili for young people and adults, a first-Friday Irish music session, and an annual Irish music and dance festival.
records.what_you_do: Dance at the free monthly Ceili OG, play or listen at the first-Friday session at The Irish Center, buy festival tickets, or join as a member and attend the annual membership meeting.

schedule.text: Irish traditional music session on the first Friday of each month at 7:30 pm at The Irish Center, 6815 Emlen St. Ceili OG is a free monthly ceili, and its dates were not shown. The annual membership meeting is on October 11, 2026 at 12 noon, and that day is also the final day of the annual festival.

cost.text: Ceili OG is free. Concert and festival tickets are sold separately. The cost of the session was not stated.

first_step.how: Come to Ceili OG, the free monthly instructed ceili, or to the first-Friday Irish music session at The Irish Center, 6815 Emlen St, at 7:30 pm
first_step.basis: Ceili OG is free and instructed, and the page says it is for young people and adults; it does not use the word beginners

records.notes: IRS legal name Philadelphia Ceili Group. The group's own page is current: it announces an October 11, 2026 membership meeting, moved from its usual January timing. Ceili OG is sponsored by the group and The Irish Center. The contact page exists but was not read; no email or phone is published on the home page.

records.name: Philadelphia Civic Symphony
records.summary: A nonprofit orchestra that aims to bring classical music to historically underserved communities. It plays public concerts, often pay-what-you-wish, and its most recent listed concert was in May 2026.
records.what_you_do: Attend a public concert, or support the orchestra with a donation. The site does not say how musicians join or audition.

schedule.text: Public concerts are listed on the Events page with dates. The most recent was on Saturday, May 30, 2026, 3 to 4 pm. No upcoming date was shown when checked.

cost.text: Pay-what-you-wish. The May 2026 concert suggested $25 a person. Other events vary.

first_step.how: Go to a public concert listed on the Events page, or follow the orchestra on Instagram for new dates
first_step.basis: Concerts are open to the public, but the page does not say how to join as a player

records.notes: IRS legal name Philadelphia Civic Symphony. The home page gives the 1935 founding under the WPA Federal Music Project; that is history, not activity. The May 2026 venue is not named on the events page; Reformation Lutheran Church is the venue on other listings. No email or phone is published. The newsletter signup on the site shows a note that it is not set up. community_band is the closest tag available because no orchestra tag exists.

records.name: Rerooted Archive
records.notes: IRS address is 1320 E Barringer St, Philadelphia (19119). The website describes a digital archive of testimonies, photos and documents about Armenian identity and justice, with contributions and justice projects reached online. Partners named include law school clinics and international bodies. No Philadelphia meetings, programs or events were shown, and the only date on the site is a 2017 copyright line. Not counted as a Philadelphia group. Owner may list it as an online group if a Philadelphia program is confirmed.

first_step.basis: The site names tutoring and youth programs but does not say how to join, so the way in is unclear

records.name: Notsolatin
records.summary: A performance space and recording studio in Philadelphia that presents artists in an intimate setting. It has shows on Tuesdays and Fridays and Big-Band Sundays, and it was founded in 2018.
records.what_you_do: Go to a show and pay a suggested donation at the door, or join the weekly mailing list. Artists can send booking inquiries.

schedule.text: Performances on Tuesdays and Fridays, with doors at 7 pm and shows at 7:30 pm, plus Big-Band Sundays announced separately. Event images on the site had no readable dates when checked.

cost.text: Suggested $20 donation at the door. Tickets are not sold in advance unless stated.

first_step.how: Come to a Tuesday or Friday show (doors 7 pm), pay the suggested $20 at the door, or join the weekly mailing list through the site's Google Form
first_step.basis: Shows are open to the public with a suggested donation, and the site says how to join the mailing list

records.notes: IRS filing address is 22 E Clapier St (zip 19144); the site gives 1440 W. Ritner Street, which is used here. No dated events were readable. The site also shows a template address, not recorded. Status is probably_active on the rule for a working site with no dates.

notes: The batch file holds 15 groups, not 25 (the file name says 25); all 15 were worked. Searches: 2 of 2, both spent on groups with no usable web address (Kuvuna Foundation found nothing; Northwest CLT found a Givebutter page and no dated news). Fetches: 25. Healthy Caregiver returned empty content on three tries, so it is recorded as unknown and held back. No rate limiting was seen; the 403 and 404 pages are listed under blocked. Verdicts: 11 publish (3 active, 4 probably_active, 1 dormant, 3 unknown), 1 hide (private), 1 not_a_group, 2 out_of_area. The two unknown records with no summary (Healthy Caregiver, Kuvuna) are held back by design; Northwest CLT is unknown with a summary and will show only if the owner accepts a low-confidence listing. Not verified on the group's own site: Kuvuna, Healthy Caregiver, Northwest CLT. No dashes were used in the text.
